Body.Content:
Tenant admins will be able to define the default value for "Days of email to save" in Offline settings and designate whether end users can change the setting. This policy will set and enforce the "Days of email to save" setting found under Settings > General > Offline. #newoutlookforwindows

GA date: November CY2026
